tool_args.rationale: The barrier-activation and base-field/sink-gradient signatures favor the barrier-modulated siphon model, but its four parameters remain weakly constrained by five rows. The available open-branch probe is the least-cost relevant follow-up to clarify the branch contribution before fitting and confirmation; the existing sink-gradient span is already broad, so no additional gradient-span-only evidence is needed.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the four-parameter barrier-modulated siphon law directly
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five training rows for four nonlinear parameters provide weak identifiability and no fresh confirmation.
This is intended for the coupled-memory ODE; the pilot signatures instead support a barrier/sink response.
It is explicitly irrelevant to identifying the target law.
